full_page.content:
Page 132 Cont.
Mar. 15 Donald Aiken - 9 - near Jackson - non cath. - in accident 7 yrs. ago - was unconscious two months .... still unable to talk but otherwise - Enrolled Today.
Mar. 16 Thanks - Baby James D. Sullivan - 8 months - spinal maningitis and pneumonia - pronounced dying. Drs. requested that the Mother - sick herself - should be removed from the hospital .... The father came and asked for prayers. Could hardly speak .... Baby is now a bright hustler of nine years. - wants to be a priest.
Mrs. Julia White - 53 - Nerve-trouble - palsey too for some two years.
Thanks ... Mrs. Cath. Davis - 49 - on way to St. Jos. hospital was inscribed at Monastery as against womb cancer ... January 11 Drs. astonished to find only bag of puss. She is here To-day in perfect health. Deo Gr.
Page 133
Mar. 19 Anna Mauer - 88 - pneumonia
19 John Stege - 68 - of Buchtel, 0. - 7 yrs. paralyzed, quite helpless - understands perfectly and seems to quite appreciate a joke, but can hardly pronounce a word. He and his sister keep a farm and find it hard at times, especially since she suffers herself from diabetis.
20th Thanks - John English - 10 - threatened double mastoid and spinal maningitis, unconscious for six days - 106 fever; was enrolled March 4th in Ser. Masses - was home March 13th Deo Gr. Here Today appar- ently O.K.
Lawrence Scoball - 37 - scaphfrenia - very peculiar mental trouble for five yrs.
Mrs. Root Mr. Root - he methodist
Mr. Norman prestiterian - 40 - asks prayers for guidance for self and One-time weak in .. alcolic.
Mary McDonald - 19 - weak spells - nervous for about a year; now nervous quite continually ....
Jos. Geo. Bell - 63 and Wife Nellie - Latter just returned from China - Exchanged - 16 living children - Husband and two boys still in c ....
